summary: Going to propose a task force at my #highered university to investigate the possibilities of ending task forces. Will include two subcommittees: 1) tasked with writing a white paper on how writing white papers lead to no action and 2:) a subcommittee on ending subcommittees.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: Going to propose a task force at my #highered university to investigate the possibilities of ending task forces. Will include two subcommittees: 1) tasked with writing a white paper on how writing white papers lead to no action and 2:) a subcommittee on ending subcommittees.
